A head start, from three starting points.

  1. Find games you love.

    Browse worlds, try available demos and inspect their source.

  2. Collect your ingredients.

    Add up to three games to your bag and describe what you’d make.

  3. Continue with Astra.

    HeadStart opens ChatGPT and copies your Gauntlet Loop prompt. Paste it into a chat with Astra to shape the brief, choose mockups, build and review.

The local MCP plugin supports research discovery today. The website cannot prefill a ChatGPT prompt or sync this bag automatically; game remixing and royalty logging are still to be built. Download the plugin and see installation steps →
